correctness.rationale: The six even K5 Hamilton cycles satisfy each of the 120 separation triples by an A5 transitivity plus three-orbit witness argument. Distinct candidate-edge OR signatures necessarily form an antichain of fifteen sets, exceeding the maximum ten 5-bit antichain. The first-stage triple-incidence construction is checked case by case for zero, three, four, five and six positive tests; all remaining patterns force >2 defectives. The executable independent finite checks pass every 16-item defective subset and all 26-item subsets of size <=4. The mathematical proof, not finite enumeration, establishes the result for every m>=5.
